tasks.natural_request: In scripts/hive_node_peer_registry.py, make the Bonjour HMAC signature bind every advertised TXT field that affects peer identity, routing, roles, or capabilities: txtvers, hive_id, node_id, node_name, api_url, relay_url, roles, and caps. verify_bonjour_txt must also require sig_alg to equal hmac-sha256. Preserve valid signed discovery and extend the existing Hive authority-security tests.

In scripts/viea_action_executor.py, make validate_action canonicalize executable script paths and reject relative or absolute parent traversal and symlink-resolved escapes outside the repository scripts directory before applying the per-kind filename allowlist. Preserve legitimate allowlisted scripts and add focused executor tests for traversal and symlink cases.

In scripts/report_evidence_integrity.py, add pack_payload_sha256 to every standard evidence pack, computed deterministically over every other pack field except validation_state and pack_payload_sha256 itself. validate_evidence_pack must reject a missing or mismatched payload hash so command and compact-receipt tampering cannot retain GREEN validation. Preserve the existing source-digest and no-cheat checks and extend the existing integrity tests.
